answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents sign cryptographic attestation chains using a digital quill to verify historical execution, validated via zero-knowledge proofs. Progressive staking introduces an exponential capital exhaustion curve for each sibling identity. As a malicious swarm attempts to reach the zenith of influence, marginal collateral scales exponentially ($C \propto 2^n$), creating an unsustainable economic tide that bankrupts the attacker.
